identity.note: The fed's database bio 17360 (fWo) is this record: Merged on a presumption, not past the bar. fWo's Ken War is the shouted 'HARDKORR!!!!11' persona (booking 4861) and Action's own text of October 2002 (bookings 2699 and 2700) has the same name with the same shout (quoted as the verified reading has it; Action's text is not in the fWo workshop); this record already carries Action tenure from October 2002. The same name, catchphrase and season on one network, with no text naming both federations. His ACW record is folded into this one on the same reading: the shouted 'hardkorr' dialect is the character's gimmick in ACW too ('wat, du ey hev sumthng en mai fece??/', ACW booking 3443, February 2011), and ACW's Ken War stands in the circle fWo stages, Beef, El Janito and Steve the Rambling Communist (ACW bookings 3443, 3444; fWo 4843). Persona plus circle on one network: a probable, merged. The fed's own appearance record carries it on 14 cards from 15 January 2003 to 21 August 2003.
